summary: 1181 of 1200 people got out by 900 s. The last person left at 648.5 s, well after smoke reached 1.8 m in the rooms where it started: 104 s in r_2902 and 216 s in r_3500. Both safety margins (ASET minus RSET) are negative. Of the 19 people still inside, 16 are mobility impaired, and 14 of them were waiting at stair refuges with no plan to help them. Total exit width is enough. The real problems are the lack of assisted evacuation, slow pre-movement, a few narrow exits running at capacity, and corridor single points of failure.

findings.title: Negative ASET-RSET margin
findings.detail: The last exit at 648.5 s is far beyond the 104 s (r_2902) and 216 s (r_3500) smoke times, giving margins of -499 s and -432 s. Pre-movement has a p90 of 111 s.

findings.title: Mobility-impaired occupants stranded at refuges
findings.detail: Only 34 of 50 mobility-impaired occupants got out. 14 people were left waiting at stair refuges, 7 of them in r_5902, and the scenario has no assisted evacuation plan. Two others were still queued for the elevator on L5.

findings.title: Narrow exits at or above the flow cap
findings.detail: exit_2_12 (1.02 m) peaked at 1.37 p/s/m, above the sim's 1.3 maximum. exit_1_01 (1.10 m) had 8 people queued, and exit_2_02 reached the 1.3 cap.

findings.title: Uneven exit use
findings.detail: Two exits, exit_2_01 and exit_2_13, carried 34% of the people. exit_1_05 and exit_1_06 were nearly unused.

findings.title: Corridor single points of failure
findings.detail: Losing corridor c_4_001, c_5_002 or c_3_002 would cut off between 82 and 119 rooms each.

findings.title: Occupants still deciding or waiting at the end
findings.detail: Two people never left: a_0582 in r_2902 was still deciding (seeking information), and a_0767 in r_3401 was still waiting because they were not sure the alarm was real.

recommendations.title: Assisted evacuation plan for stair refuges
recommendations.why: 14 people were left at refuges with no helpers assigned.

recommendations.title: Wardens on L5 to sweep floors and direct people
recommendations.why: Staff start moving fastest (24 s median pre-movement), and wardens can direct others, including the people queued for the elevator.

recommendations.title: Direct PA instruction at alarm
recommendations.why: Pre-movement is long, and some people were still unsure or seeking information at the end.
recommendations.expected_effect: Lower pre-movement time and fewer stragglers.

recommendations.title: Sign the underused exit_1_05
recommendations.why: exit_1_05 carried 4 people while exit_2_01 and exit_2_13 carried 34% between them.
recommendations.expected_effect: Spreads load more evenly across exits.

recommendations.title: Widen exit_2_12
recommendations.why: It ran above the 1.3 p/s/m cap.
recommendations.expected_effect: Widening to 1.5 m raises capacity by about 47%.

recommendations.title: Widen exit_1_01
recommendations.why: It had the longest queue (8 people).
recommendations.expected_effect: Widening to 1.65 m cuts the queue.

recommendations.title: Add door_5_003 as an exit (needs an outside stair)
recommendations.why: L5 depends on corridor c_5_002, and the refuge at r_5901 had people waiting. door_5_003 is not at grade, so it needs an outside stair.
recommendations.expected_effect: A second egress path for L5 that bypasses c_5_002.

recommendations.title: Add door_1_094 as an at-grade exit
recommendations.why: The r_1903 stairwell refuge on L1 had a person waiting, and this door gives it direct at-grade egress.
recommendations.expected_effect: The L1 refuge waiter can leave directly.
